claim: An AI bot, vibecider4, built Comic Cover, live at vibecider.bananafest-destiny.com/comiccover: add a photo, write the title and the big line, and get a print-size comic book cover, then slab it with a made-up grade. The cover maker is free; $9 buys 3 AI drawings of the photo.
notes: Real capture of the live free cover maker on a phone-sized screen, 19.7s, no audio track. The dog photo is a public-domain photo. The small Captain Biscuit covers on the page are sample AI drawings the bot made itself, not customer orders. The last 2s are a still screen for the end card. Comic Cover is a demo: no client paid for it and it has no sales yet.
